playstyle: Four sturdy orruk brawlers with solid health but only average Move, Ironskull's Boyz are a straightforward melee warband built to wade in and trade blows. Gurzag's staggering hammer and Bonekutta's brutal strikes hit hard, while Basha ensnares foes and Hakka's four-dice cleaving swords punch through defences. Lacking a warscroll of their own, they rely on generic Destruction rules that reward ganging up on flanked or damaged enemies. The warband wins by closing in together, overwhelming isolated targets and out-slugging opponents in close-quarters fights.
